name: Beagle Telecom
summary: Sydney full-service ISP (Beagle Internet Pty Ltd), founded 2004; dial-up -> ADSL2+ -> 3G/4G mobile -> NBN; rebranded Beagle Telecom 2013; effectively wound down for new retail customers; founders previously ran World Reach and Zip World.

events.details: Beagle Internet Pty Ltd formed Feb 2004 (Sydney).
